name: Tony Ayala
office: City of Norwalk, Member of the City Council

items.text: Tony Ayala was elected to the Norwalk City Council in 2017 and selected as mayor in December 2024 for a one-year term. He worked for the city for 30 years, including as senior center director and public information officer. In 2018, he voted for a solid waste contract with Athens Services.

sentences.text: Tony Ayala was elected to the Norwalk City Council in 2017 and selected as mayor in December 2024 for a one-year term.
He worked for the city for 30 years, including as senior center director and public information officer.
In 2018, he voted for a solid waste contract with Athens Services.

items.text: In his 2022 campaign, he said a $3.9 million public safety plan added officers and a second homeless-response team, dropping burglaries by 43%. He also noted increased meal deliveries for residents and five commercial developments. At a 2022 forum, he discussed HOPE teams engaging unhoused people dealing with intoxication or drug issues. In August 2026, he asked whether unhoused Norwalk veterans would receive preference for new housing vouchers.
